SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.CPK < 250
)
